name: tpl-existence-1-goal
task: Pick up the key, then reach the goal.

value.feedback: NO CHANGES NEEDED: the task 'Pick up the key, then reach the goal' is the 'do a, then b' form, correctly captured by hard Existence(at_goal) plus hard Precedence(has_key, at_goal); together they force has_key before any at_goal, so no Existence(has_key) is needed and none is present. The machine confirms this: u3 is final only via at_goal with has_key already seen, and at_goal before has_key leads to the rejecting state; 'Every way to finish includes: has_key, at_goal' matches exactly what the task requires.

texts: Pick up the key before reaching the goal.
machine:
REWARD_MACHINE:
STATES: u0, u1, u2, u3
INITIAL_STATE: u0
FINAL_STATES: u3
REJECTING_STATES: u2
DEFAULT_REWARD: 0
TRANSITION_FUNCTION:
(u0, !at_goal&has_key) -> u1
(u0, at_goal&!has_key) -> u2
(u0, at_goal&has_key) -> u3
(u1, at_goal) -> u3
REWARD_FUNCTION:
(u0, !at_goal&has_key, u1) -> 1
(u0, at_goal&!has_key, u2) -> -10
(u0, at_goal&has_key, u3) -> 12
(u1, at_goal, u3) -> 11
